basis: The baseline production code allows an ISBN and URL miss to fall through to title-and-publisher soft matching.
The fixed production code restricts the soft lookup population and the final soft-match branch to books without both ISBN and URL strong identities.
The fixed commit therefore contains a substantive production correction for the frozen candidate root cause rather than only a test change.
The frozen regression test calls createFakeSupabase with isbnRows only.
The fake returns options.softRows or an empty array for the title-and-publisher lookup, and the regression test does not provide softRows.
On the baseline, the second book misses the ISBN and URL maps and reaches the soft path, but the empty soft result leaves softMap without a matching identity, so the result is null.
On the fixed code, the second book has strong identities and bypasses the soft branch, so the result is also null.
The asserted result is therefore identical for baseline and fixed even though the production correction is substantive.
